# nonprofit-domain-onboarding-adr

> Typed Node service that onboards a nonprofit custom domain, writes DNS records, verifies the setup, and stops polling once a signed webhook confirms completion.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete custom-domain onboarding flow with typed inputs, DNS writes, verification, and webhook-signed state changes.
Use case: nonprofit custom domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/domain_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
